entries.title: Genesis 20:1
segments: ¶And Abraham journeyed from there to the South, and dwelt between Kadesh and Shur, and stayed in Gerar.

entries.title: Genesis 20:2
segments: Now Abraham said of Sarah his wife, "She [is] my sister." And Abimelech king of Gerar sent and took Sarah.

entries.title: Genesis 20:3
segments: ¶But God came to Abimelech in a dream by night, and said to him, "Indeed you [are] a dead man because of the woman whom you have taken, for she [is] a man's wife."

entries.title: Genesis 20:4
segments: But Abimelech had not come near her; and he said, "Lord, will You slay a righteous nation also?

entries.title: Genesis 20:5
segments: "Did he not say to me, 'She [is] my sister'? And she, even she herself said, 'He [is] my brother.' In the integrity of my heart and innocence of my hands I have done this."

entries.title: Genesis 20:6
segments: And God said to him in a dream, "Yes, I know that you did this in the integrity of your heart. For I also withheld you from sinning against Me; therefore I did not let you touch her.

entries.title: Genesis 20:7
segments: "Now therefore, restore the man's wife; for he [is] a prophet, and he will pray for you and you shall live. But if you do not restore [her], know that you shall surely die, you and all who [are] yours."

entries.title: Genesis 20:8
segments: ¶So Abimelech rose early in the morning, called all his servants, and told all these things in their hearing; and the men were very much afraid.

entries.title: Genesis 20:9
segments: And Abimelech called Abraham and said to him, "What have you done to us? How have I offended you, that you have brought on me and on my kingdom a great sin? You have done deeds to me that ought not to be done."

entries.title: Genesis 20:10
segments: Then Abimelech said to Abraham, "What did you have in view, that you have done this thing?"

entries.title: Genesis 20:11
segments: And Abraham said, "Because I thought, surely the fear of God [is] not in this place; and they will kill me on account of my wife.

entries.title: Genesis 20:12
segments: "But indeed [she is] truly my sister. She [is] the daughter of my father, but not the daughter of my mother; and she became my wife.

entries.title: Genesis 20:13
segments: "And it came to pass, when God caused me to wander from my father's house, that I said to her, 'This [is] your kindness that you should do for me: in every place, wherever we go, say of me, "He [is] my brother."'"

entries.title: Genesis 20:14
segments: ¶Then Abimelech took sheep, oxen, and male and female servants, and gave [them] to Abraham; and he restored Sarah his wife to him.

entries.title: Genesis 20:15
segments: And Abimelech said, "See, my land [is] before you; dwell where it pleases you."

entries.title: Genesis 20:16
segments: Then to Sarah he said, "Behold, I have given your brother a thousand [pieces] of silver; indeed this vindicates you before all who [are] with you and before everybody." Thus she was rebuked.

entries.title: Genesis 20:17
segments: So Abraham prayed to God; and God healed Abimelech, his wife, and his female servants. Then they bore [children];

entries.title: Genesis 20:18
segments: for the LORD had closed up all the wombs of the house of Abimelech because of Sarah, Abraham's wife.
